verdict.rationale: No evidence of bulk data export in open/standard formats or a documented data-portability/exit path; CLI (sf data query) supports querying but not evidenced as a full open-format export mechanism. Missing for 10: documented bulk export tools (e.g., Data Loader/Bulk API) producing open formats like CSV/JSON, data portability/exit guarantees, and any independent confirmation of a clean 'leave with your data' workflow.
